questions.wording: When the Ramp team hands the loading report back to the Load controller, what passes across and how?
probes: Is it a document, a call or a message?
What happens when it arrives late?

questions.wording: When a special load turns up at the aircraft, who on the Ramp side decides what happens next, and who is told?
probes: Does it always work that way?

questions.wording: Which activities around loading does the Ramp team manage, and which belong to Load control? Where do they overlap?
probes: Who is held accountable when the figures don't match?

questions.wording: The SOP says the loading report comes back within 10 minutes. Does it?
Who on the Ramp side can stop loading if something looks wrong, and how do they let the others know?
